open_release.rationale: The paper frames synthetic EHRs as a way to avoid sharing real patient records and tests privacy attacks.

quotes.text: Synthetic EHRs generation bypasses the need to share sensitive real patient records.

pipeline_testing.rationale: No testing or format-conformance framing appears in the sources.

ml_augmentation.rationale: The paper trains a predictor on synthetic data and on synthetic plus real data, calling the latter data augmentation.

quotes.text: the synthetic data is regarded as data augmentation.

statistical_replication.rationale: Fidelity is evaluated with perplexity measures on MIMIC-III against baselines.

quotes.text: Experiments on MIMIC-III data demonstrate the superiority of our methods on realistic EHRs generation (53.1\% decrease of lpl and 45.3\% decrease of mpl on average compared to the best baselines) with low privacy risks.

causal_inference.rationale: No causal graph or intervention framing appears.

education.rationale: No teaching or tutorial framing appears; the README demo only shows usage.

benchmarking.rationale: PromptEHR is the proposed method and the sources never show it used as a baseline or benchmark.

imbalance_correction.rationale: No class-imbalance or minority-class experiments appear.
